grammarName.en: The passive for processes (is made, has been improved, is said to)
grammarName.ru: Пассив для процессов (is made, has been improved, is said to)

scenario: Pol finally reveals how his legendary office smoothie is made, giving a mock TV-chef explanation — so the episode is full of the passive for processes, the perfect passive, and 'it is said that / is said to'. Pol: 'First, the fruit is washed. Then it is cut and put into the blender. The banana is added at the end.' Perfect passive: 'The recipe has been improved over five years.' Modal/future passive: 'It must be drunk fresh. It will be served cold.' Reported passive: 'It is said to give you energy. It is said that Pol never shares the recipe.' Den is sure he can copy it; Peter takes notes. Warm, funny, on-brand (smoothies are Pol's thing). Use clear passives: present (is washed/is added), perfect (has been improved), modal/future (must be drunk / will be served), and 'it is said that / is said to'. Short B1 sentences.
